description.intro: Liverpool's adidas rope backpack is the practical and lightweight option to take the essentials. With minimalist design and club shield, it is perfect for training, fast errands or casual urban looks.

Easy to carry: Ultralight, comfortable and versatile.
Compact size: Ideal for light equipment or daily use.
Versatilidad total: Perfecta para entrenar o moverte por la ciudad.
